trap.label: particípio sem sujeito
trap.wrong: Not wanting to create conflict, the meeting was short.
trap.right: Not wanting to create conflict, I kept the meeting short.
trap.why: O sujeito do particípio deve ser o da principal. Em português isso não é cobrado; em inglês, evite o dangling participle.

mcq.q: Not wanting conflict, ___ kept it short.

fix.wrong: Having review the notes, I agree.
fix.right: Having reviewed the notes, I agree.

fix.wrong: Not wanting conflict, the talk was short.
fix.right: Not wanting conflict, I kept the talk short.

rewrite.prompt: Particípio: “After I had reviewed the notes, I agreed.”
rewrite.answer: Having reviewed the notes, I agreed.

rewrite.prompt: Particípio negativo: “Because I did not want conflict, I left.”
Particípio: “After she had finished it, she agreed.”
